Kids + FAMILIES

ALL PEOPLE MATTER.

FROM THE YOUNGEST TO THE OLDEST.

Nursery

0-2 years old
Our nursery will keep your kids safe while you're in service. Opt to have us change diapers and provide snacks or text you when a change is needed.
To join in, check your kids in for a regularly scheduled service.

PreK

3-4 years old
Our teachers will help your kids learn while you're in service. Age-appropriate teaching and engaging activities help everyone learn best!
To join in, check your kids in for a regularly scheduled service.

Kids Church

Kindergarten - 5th
Our teachers will help your kids learn and apply God's Word mid-way through services. This way, kids can join parents in worship then go to Kids Church!
To join in, check your kids in for a regularly scheduled service.

Youth Group

Jr. & Sr. High
Our youth team will help your teens discuss and process the sermon and God's Word. To do this, teens gather in a small group setting with our leaders on Fridays.
To join in, get in touch for more details and locations.

KEEP KIDS SAFE
WITH CHECK-IN

We use Planning Center to keep your kids safe and secure.

Every volunteer is background checked and trained. Every kids area has a secure check-in before service.
The first time you bring your kids to a service, our volunteers will help you get started, but then it's really simple. You can check in using just the last 4 digits of your phone number!

Or check in before you even leave your car with our system's mobile app. Download the app, then search for Crosspoint Lynchburg to get started.
